notes: Property keys and values are the canonical response vocabulary for property probes. Per-example values stay protected.
Visibility is a draft per-property judgement of what rendered gameplay frames can show. Reviewers must confirm it per example and per evidence arm.

telemetry_only properties cannot be recovered from pixels. If a label-decisive property is telemetry_only, the visual-only arms must be reviewed as INSUFFICIENT; use gold_by_condition and exclude the example from paired lexical claims.
Melee mechanics descriptions were transcribed offline from community knowledge and are unverified against game data in this project. AoE II families have no telemetry validator in this toolkit.

Inventory joins are thin. All five Melee senses have usages from one SSBWiki page (Mr. Game & Watch (SSBM)); most AoE senses come from one forum thread. The fighting-game glossary excerpt attributed to Melee 'wavedash' in GAME_TERM_INVENTORY_2026-10-06_EVIDENCE.csv describes the Tekken/MvC sense.

visibility_classes.visible: Decidable from rendered frames under the frozen frame-selection rule.
visibility_classes.visible_native_rate_only: Decidable from frames only if consecutive native 60 Hz frames around the defining transition are kept (key frame and predecessor are required in the selection).
visibility_classes.context_dependent: Visible only when the camera, framing or HUD shows it; reviewers mark per example.
visibility_classes.telemetry_only: Not in pixels: controller inputs or internal flags. Visual-only arms are INSUFFICIENT for this property by design.
visibility_classes.not_observable: Intent or strategy that neither frames nor telemetry establish; excluded from scoring.

Super Smash Bros. Melee.telemetry_validator: Slippi replay + melee_mining.py rules (constants unverified on real replays)

Age of Empires II: Definitive Edition.telemetry_validator: none in toolkit; aoc-mgz parsing not integrated

wavedash.plain_description: a jump that is cut short at once by an air dodge angled into the ground, so the character lands immediately and slides along the floor

critical_properties.note: Jumpsquat lasts a few frames; uniform subsampling can erase it.

near_miss_kinds.jump_airdodge_no_landing: Jump then air dodge that does not land at once.
near_miss_kinds.waveland_without_jumpsquat: Air dodge into the ground from a fall or platform, with no jump start.

wrong_context_sources: Tekken or Marvel vs. Capcom 'wavedash' footage (a different crouch-dash input sense)
Super Smash Bros. Ultimate air-dodge landings
wavedash.visual_only_expectation: Decidable if native-rate frames around jumpsquat, air dodge and landing are kept.

L-cancel.plain_description: landing an aerial attack while pressing a shield button just before touching the ground, which halves the landing recovery time

critical_properties.telemetry: L/R/Z physical buttons or analog trigger within 7 frames before landing
critical_properties.note: Not rendered unless an input-display overlay is captured; overlays would be privileged evidence and are excluded.

critical_properties.telemetry: Slippi post-frame L-cancel status (1 success, 2 fail) when present
critical_properties.note: In principle countable from native-rate landing frames with a per-move landing-lag table. Treat as telemetry_only unless an expert reviewer counts frames. Vanilla Melee is believed to show no success flash (unverified). Mr. Game & Watch cannot L-cancel most aerials (source quote).

near_miss_kinds.l_cancel_missed: Aerial landing without a successful L-cancel.
near_miss_kinds.aerial_autocancel_landing: Aerial ends before landing (normal landing state); nothing to cancel.

L-cancel.visual_only_expectation: Designed control: visual-only arms are expected to be INSUFFICIENT for PRESENT versus ABSENT.

dashdancing.plain_description: repeatedly starting a dash and reversing direction within the opening dash, before the character breaks into a run

critical_properties.telemetry: No Run (21) between reversals; gaps of 20 frames or fewer

near_miss_kinds.foxtrot_same_direction: Repeated dashes in one direction (the source names foxtrotting separately).
near_miss_kinds.single_dashback: One reversal only; community usage is ambiguous, so review it.

wrong_context_sources: Ultimate dash-dance footage (different engine, same name)
dashdancing.visual_only_expectation: Decidable if dash and run animations are distinguishable at the selected rate.

short hop.plain_description: a low jump from the ground made by releasing the jump button before the character leaves the ground

critical_properties.telemetry: apex height compared with the same character's other jumps in the replay
critical_properties.note: Character-dependent; reviewers need a same-character reference.

critical_properties.telemetry: X/Y or tap-jump stick on the last jumpsquat frame

wrong_context_sources: Short hops in other Smash titles or platform fighters
short hop.visual_only_expectation: Decidable by height with a character reference; the input mechanism stays telemetry_only.

edgehogging.plain_description: holding onto the stage edge so a recovering opponent cannot grab it

critical_properties.telemetry: opponent airborne on the same side beyond or below the holder
critical_properties.note: The camera usually frames both players; far-offstage recoveries can leave the frame.

critical_properties.telemetry: opponent does not catch the ledge during the overlap
stock decrease or dead state; otherwise ledge or stage return

near_miss_kinds.ledge_held_opponent_recovered: Ledge held while the opponent is offstage, but the opponent recovers.

wrong_context_sources: Edge-guarding by attacks without ledge occupancy (separate term)
edgehogging.visual_only_expectation: Mostly visible; context_dependent when the opponent is off-camera.

FC.game: Age of Empires II: Definitive Edition
FC.plain_description: a build that advances through the second age quickly to reach the third age as early as possible

critical_properties.note: Needs the HUD age indicator and game clock in frame.

near_miss_kinds.standard_feudal_play: Normal second-age play before a later age-up.

FC.visual_only_expectation: Short clips rarely establish it; a long-horizon strategic term.

Trush.game: Age of Empires II: Definitive Edition
Trush.plain_description: building defensive towers near the opponent's resources early in the game to deny them

near_miss_kinds.defensive_tower_at_home: A tower in the builder's own base.

wrong_context_sources: Tower rushes in other RTS titles
Trush.visual_only_expectation: Visible only when the recording's camera is on the forward towers.

deer pushing.game: Age of Empires II: Definitive Edition
deer pushing.plain_description: using the scout to herd deer toward the town center so villagers can hunt them nearby

near_miss_kinds.scout_exploring_near_deer: The scout passes deer without herding them.

wrong_context_sources: Sheep scouting (a related but distinct practice)
deer pushing.visual_only_expectation: Visible when the camera follows the scout.

drush.game: Age of Empires II: Definitive Edition
drush.plain_description: an early attack with a small group of first-age militia
drush.visual_only_expectation: Visible when the HUD shows the first age and the camera shows the attack.

3 TC booming.game: Age of Empires II: Definitive Edition
3 TC booming.plain_description: building two extra town centers early in the third age to grow the economy
3 TC booming.visual_only_expectation: Long horizon; frames rarely show all three town centers.
